title: Mordheim KB catalogue — catalog/rules/conditions.yaml
description: Conditions shared by rules (fear, frenzy, stupidity …). A condition is editorial text with a stable id that rules reference instead of restating the effect. A condition that the current duel runtime can supply declares a `runtime` block with the same shape as a rule's, so one canonical id resolves to the operator the engine already consumes. `condition.fear` is the printed general Fear rule, not a per-warrior condition, and records that disposition with an unbound NO effect.

note.description: Editorial note about the catalogue as a whole.

condition_runtime.description: Executable link of a condition. A condition without this block is unclassified, not implemented; a condition that the caller may supply as a current warrior fact declares its operator here so no adapter needs a second interpretation table.

scope.description: Widest scope over the condition's effects.

implemented.description: `YES` only when every `YES` effect has an executable binding.

grant.description: A supplied condition grants nothing by itself, so only `none` applies.

variant_fact.description: Supplied warrior fact that selects between the printed variants of a condition whose source prints more than one version; the caller must provide it and the compiler refuses an unknown or missing value.

condition_runtime_effect.description: One classified effect of a condition. It declares its scope and either an executable binding or the reason it has none.

scope.description: `YES` belongs to the current duel runtime; `NO` is out of scope.

variant.description: Printed variant of `variant_fact` this effect belongs to; a variant-less effect applies to every supplied value.

binding.description: The executable link, or null when the effect has none.

reason.description: Required whenever there is no binding.
